correctness.rationale: For each k>=1, Tuffley’s exp_k(S1) integral sphere homotopy type S^(2ceil(k/2)-1), almost-free rotation action, and finite isotropy of order <=2k give the mod-p/characteristic-zero Borel-to-orbit comparison for Q and odd p>k. The Serre transgression d_(2m)(xi)=c*u^m is nonzero by finite-dimensionality; its truncated F[u] ring and inversion u->-u under reflection give F[u^2]/((u^2)^ceil(k/4)). Transfer for the reflection is permissible since 2 invertible. Universal coefficient and agreement of Fp/Q ranks rule out p-primary torsion for p>k, not all small-prime torsion. Independent dihedral index enumerator checked j=1..20; Euler stratum chi_c=1 when j=1(mod4), zero otherwise, consistent with cumulative ceil(k/4). The finite checks corroborate, not prove, the all-k spectral argument.
